name: Acceleration-aware time-to-bank-level: second difference, quadratic persistence extrapolation, least-n horizon search, with refusal

statement.latest: \text{Given } \Delta_k(t) \text{ from PROP-FLOOD-01 and its own retained difference one lag back (both requiring the retained samples in } [t-2k,t] \text{), the second difference } D2_k(t) := \Delta_k(t) - \Delta_k(t-k).\quad \boxed{\text{ALREADY\_AT\_BANK}} \text{ when } \theta \le h(t) \text{ -- checked FIRST, a real answer, never a refusal.}\quad \text{Otherwise, for } n \in \mathbb{N},\ n \ge 1,\ \text{the quadratic persistence-extrapolation level at } n \text{ further } k\text{-tick strides: } L(n) := h(t) + n\cdot\Delta_k(t) + \tfrac{n(n+1)}{2}\cdot D2_k(t).\quad \text{ETA (strides)} := \text{least } n\in[1,N_{max}] \text{ with } L(n) \ge \theta; \text{ETA (ticks)} := n\cdot k.\quad \theta \text{ an official agency bank/overbank level (min\_bank, or critical as the alternative)}.\quad \boxed{\text{REFUSED (NO\_READOUT} \mid \text{PUMP\_STATE\_CHANGED} \mid \text{PUMP\_STATE\_UNDECLARED} \mid \text{SPARSE\_SERIES} \mid \text{NO\_RISE} \mid \text{NOT\_WITHIN\_HORIZON)}} \text{ -- never a guessed or averaged number. Precedence (checked in this order): ALREADY\_AT\_BANK} > \text{NO\_READOUT} > \text{PUMP} > \text{SPARSE\_SERIES} > \text{NO\_RISE} > \text{NOT\_WITHIN\_HORIZON}.
statement.note_ascii: ALREADY_AT_BANK (checked FIRST, before any retained-difference input is even inspected): when theta <= h(t), the water is already at or over the bank -- a real, positive answer the founder needs, never a refusal and never folded into NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON. Otherwise: D2_k(t) := Delta_k(t) - Delta_k(t-k), the retained second difference (PROP-FLOOD-01's Delta_k applied to its own output one lag back; both Delta_k(t) and Delta_k(t-k) need the retained samples in the window [t-2k, t] -- h(t) itself is a PRECONDITION of this whole construction (without a current retained sample there is no readout at all, not a NO_READOUT case); if h(t-k) or h(t-2k) is missing -- i.e. Delta_k(t) or Delta_k(t-k) is itself undefined -- the construction is NO_READOUT, a determinate refusal, never a silently-assumed zero difference). The quadratic persistence-extrapolation level at n further k-tick strides forward from the current retained tick t: L(n) := h(t) + n*Delta_k(t) + (n(n+1)/2)*D2_k(t), n a nat (n(n+1)/2 always a nonnegative rational). ETA in strides is the least n in [1,N_max] (a declared finite horizon) with L(n) >= theta; ETA in ticks = n*k, n counting strides. theta an official agency bank-level threshold (the agency's own min_bank / overbank word by default; critical as the declared alternative). The pump state is a 3-way declared flag -- CHANGED / UNCHANGED / UNDECLARED, never a bare bool -- over the window that is the retained samples [t-2k, t] used to compute Delta_k(t)/Delta_k(t-k) PLUS any change declared on the operator's own schedule for the forward extrapolation window (t, t+N_max*k]. UNDECLARED is itself an explicit, checked state: it is never silently read as UNCHANGED. Refusals, checked in this fixed precedence order and each a determinate named outcome, never a number: NO_READOUT (a required retained sample is missing) > PUMP_STATE_CHANGED (the declared pump state changed in the window) > PUMP_STATE_UNDECLARED (the pump state was never declared) > SPARSE_SERIES (the declared sample spacing exceeds a declared maximum) > NO_RISE (Delta_k(t) does not exceed PROP-FLOOD-01's resolution epsilon) > NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON (no n in [1,N_max] reaches theta).

definitions.h: PROP-FLOOD-01's Q-valued readout series (e.g. a pond/canal water-level gauge), finite ticks only
definitions.t: the current retained tick, t in N
definitions.k: the declared lag in ticks, k>=1, shared with PROP-FLOOD-01/02
definitions.Delta_k(t): PROP-FLOOD-01's lag-k retained difference at t: h(t) - h(t-k)
definitions.D2_k(t): the retained second difference: Delta_k(t) - Delta_k(t-k) -- the retained difference of PROP-FLOOD-01's own output one lag (k ticks) back; a generalisation of WP.S8.SecondDifference (delta_t^2 X_n = X_{n+1}-2X_n+X_{n-1} over Delta t^2, REGISTERED_CURRENT) from lag 1 to lag k, with the continuum /Delta t^2 normalisation dropped -- D2_k(t) stays a retained difference of retained differences, never divided into a continuum acceleration rate
definitions.n: a nat, the number of further k-tick strides from t; L is evaluated only at n>=1
definitions.N_max: a declared finite search horizon (nat); the least n is searched only inside [1, N_max]
definitions.theta: an official agency threshold: the agency's own bank-level reading (min_bank / overbank word) by default, or the agency's critical level as the declared alternative -- never a value this construction invents
definitions.eps: PROP-FLOOD-01's own declared resolution constant, reused unmodified as the rising/non-rising gate for Delta_k(t)
definitions.max_gap, gap: a declared maximum tick spacing and the actual spacing of the most recent samples used; gap > max_gap triggers SPARSE_SERIES
definitions.n (ticks): ETA reported in ticks = n*k, where n is the number of k-tick strides counted by the search (see 'n' above); the two are never conflated.
definitions.pump: a declared 3-way flag -- CHANGED / UNCHANGED / UNDECLARED, never a bare bool -- over the window [t-2k, t] (the retained samples used to compute Delta_k(t)/Delta_k(t-k)) plus any change declared on the operator's own schedule for the forward extrapolation window (t, t+N_max*k]. UNDECLARED is itself an explicit, checked state, refused as PUMP_STATE_UNDECLARED -- it is never silently read as UNCHANGED.
definitions.h(t) precondition: h(t), the current retained sample, is a PRECONDITION of this whole construction, not a NO_READOUT case: without a current retained sample there is no readout at all (ALREADY_AT_BANK and every other outcome below presuppose h(t) exists). NO_READOUT covers only a MISSING h(t-k) or h(t-2k) -- i.e. Delta_k(t) or Delta_k(t-k) itself undefined -- never a missing h(t).

readout_classes.eta: EtaAtBank (theta<=h0, a real answer, not a refusal) | EtaOk n (the least k-tick stride count reaching theta within the horizon; ETA in ticks = n*k) | EtaRefused(NO_READOUT | PUMP_STATE_CHANGED | PUMP_STATE_UNDECLARED | SPARSE_SERIES | NO_RISE | NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON)
readout_classes.refusal_precedence: Checked in this fixed order, first match wins: ALREADY_AT_BANK (not a refusal, checked before any retained-difference input) > NO_READOUT > PUMP_STATE_CHANGED/PUMP_STATE_UNDECLARED > SPARSE_SERIES > NO_RISE > NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON.

claim_boundary: This is a persistence EXTRAPOLATION readout of the two most recently retained differences of an already-observed series, not a physical forecast and not a hydraulic model: holding Delta_k(t) and D2_k(t) constant forward across every future k-tick stride is an assumption this construction makes visible, never a claim that the pond/canal will actually keep accelerating at that rate. A pump-state change, a new rain pulse, or any other regime change inside the extrapolated window breaks the persistence assumption outright -- this is why PUMP_STATE_CHANGED is a first-class refusal rather than a caveat attached after the fact. No rainfall-runoff, channel-routing, or storage-capacity content is asserted; theta is read from the agency, never derived.
honest_caveats: This is the riverside person's own intuition formalised: whether the water is already over the bank (ALREADY_AT_BANK, checked first, a real answer), how fast the level is rising (Delta_k), whether that rise is itself speeding up (D2_k), and when, if that keeps up, it reaches the bank -- not a claim that it will keep up.

D2_k(t) carries at least as much combined resolution slack as Delta_k(t) does (PROP-FLOOD-01's own caveat), since it differences two already-slack retained differences; a D2_k(t) too small to distinguish from zero at that combined resolution should be treated as the D2=0 (no-acceleration) case, not asserted as a measured acceleration.

theta must be an official agency reading (min_bank/overbank by default, critical as the declared alternative); an invented or interpolated threshold is out of scope and must not be substituted silently.

NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON means exactly what it says: no n in the declared [1,N_max] reaches theta under the persistence assumption -- it is not evidence that the bank will never be reached, only that this construction, at this horizon, does not license a number.

h(t) is a PRECONDITION, not a NO_READOUT case: without it there is no readout at all. NO_READOUT fires before any admissibility check (rise, spacing, pump) runs, and covers only a missing h(t-k) or h(t-2k) -- i.e. Delta_k(t) or Delta_k(t-k) itself undefined -- never a silently-treated-as-zero gap.

PUMP_STATE_UNDECLARED is the refusal most likely to be silently skipped by an implementer, precisely because 'undeclared' looks like 'nothing happened' -- the 3-way flag makes not-knowing an explicit, checked state rather than a default. The declared window covers both the retained samples [t-2k,t] used to compute Delta_k(t)/Delta_k(t-k) and the operator's own forward schedule for (t, t+N_max*k].

This EXTENDS PROP-FLOOD-02 (see parents, derived_via=extended): it does not generalise PROP-FLOOD-03's water-balance bookkeeping, and it does not need PROP-FLOOD-03's initial storage S_b(0) -- it runs entirely off the OBSERVED level series h, which is exactly the gap an earlier backtest of PROP-FLOOD-03 found (S0 undeclared everywhere) a level gauge removes.
ETA is reported two ways and the two must never be conflated: n (the stride count the search returns) and n*k (the same ETA in ticks, k being the shared lag).
Not yet implemented or tested against real Sammakorn/Bangkok pond-level gauge data; this is a design-stage proposal.
eta_readout_D2_zero_matches_T_k holds given gap<=max_gap and pump UNCHANGED -- those two administrative conditions are preconditions of the iff, not separately re-derived by it.

parents.evidence: D2_k(t) := Delta_k(t) - Delta_k(t-k) applies PROP-FLOOD-01's own lag-k retained-difference construction to PROP-FLOOD-01's own output series one lag back; this proposal supplies no new primitive beyond a second application of Delta_k, and reuses PROP-FLOOD-01's resolution gate eps unmodified as the NO_RISE condition on Delta_k(t).

At D2_k(t)=0, L(n) = h(t) + n*Delta_k(t) is exactly PROP-FLOOD-02's linear extension, and the least n in [1,N_max] with L(n)>=theta is the k-stride-discretised form of PROP-FLOOD-02's ceiling(T_k) (proved in Coq as eta_D2_zero_matches_linear, and at the eta_readout wrapper level as eta_readout_D2_zero_matches_T_k, given gap<=max_gap and pump UNCHANGED). This EXTENDS PROP-FLOOD-02 rather than only generalising it. Explicit map from PROP-FLOOD-02's own outcomes to this object's: 02 UNRESOLVED -> NO_RISE; 02 NOT_APPLICABLE (falling) -> NO_RISE; 02 NOT_APPLICABLE (h>=theta) -> EtaAtBank; 02 NOT_APPLICABLE (NO_READOUT input) -> NO_READOUT. Added outright, with no PROP-FLOOD-02 counterpart: PUMP_STATE_CHANGED, PUMP_STATE_UNDECLARED, SPARSE_SERIES, NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON.

WP.S8.SecondDifference (REGISTERED_CURRENT, statement 'delta_t^2 X_n = (X_{n+1} - 2 X_n + X_{n-1}) / Delta t^2') is the lag-1, continuum-normalised second time-difference. D2_k(t) is its generalisation to a declared lag k, with the /Delta t^2 continuum normalisation dropped: this object keeps D2_k(t) as a retained difference of retained differences on finite ticks, never a divided rate, matching the workspace's own no-derivative discipline (information-discrete-math). Verified REGISTERED_CURRENT via `toledo find "WP.S8"` and `toledo show`, .

The interval-enclosure form (eta_interval_enclosure, level_box_enclosure) applies PROP-FLOOD-10a's own enclosure_sound theorem UNCHANGED to the 2-coordinate vector map (Delta_k, D2_k) |-> L(n), proving level_vec is sigma_monotone and invoking enclosure_sound directly -- no second enclosure object is registered. PROP-FLOOD-10a is itself an open proposal (PR #64, branch proposals/flood-forecast-ladder, not yet canonicalized); its Coq file (PROP_FLOOD_10_enclosure_nested_box.v) was imported and compiled directly, not re-derived.

monotonicity: Proved (Th_coqc-in-proposal-lane, see coq_theorems): level_mono_D2, level_mono_joint, eta_search_mono_D2, eta_search_mono_joint, eta_interval_enclosure, and the Some-propagation corollary eta_search_mono_joint_some_propagates (a slower case that already finds Some within the horizon forces a faster case to also find Some, at or before the same stride).
falsifier: A declared (h0, Delta_now, Delta_prev, theta, N_max) for which the returned EtaOk n does not satisfy L(n)>=theta, or for which some m<n (m>=1) already satisfies L(m)>=theta, would falsify search_sound (the Coq proof rules this out; an observed violation means the implementation does not match this file). A theta<=h0 case that does NOT return EtaAtBank, or an EtaAtBank return with theta>h0, would falsify eta_readout_at_bank_iff. A D2b>=D2a case whose returned n_b is strictly greater than n_a's would falsify eta_search_mono_joint/eta_search_mono_D2.

origin.source: New derivation/proposal: Sammakorn village / Bangkok pond-level flood-readout application (private), founder request 2026-10-05 (verbatim, raw, typos included): “ดูความเร่งของบึง ว่าจะล้นตลิ่งเมื่อไหร่ได้ และ สามารถ ไปดูภาพรวมแล้วจำลองการคำนวนว่าจะล้นตลิ่งเมื่อไหร่ได้ จงพัทำให้เป็น ระบบคิดสกิลหลังกของเอไอที่ต่อเข้ากับระบบที่ทำทั้งหมด” (in English: watch the pond's acceleration to tell when it will overflow its bank, and also look at the overview and simulate when it will overflow its bank; make this the core thinking skill for AIs, connected to the whole system this is built with), scoped to this object first per the founder's same-day follow-up (verbatim, raw, typos included): “เพราะในชีวิตจริง คนริมน้ำก็จะดูว่าน้ำขึ้นเร็วแค่ไหนอยู่แล้ว และ น้ำท่วาม คือน้ำล้นตลิ่งเป็นเรื่องแรก” (in English: because in real life, people by the water already watch how fast the water is rising, and flooding -- the water going over the bank -- is the first thing) then (verbatim): “โฟกัสที่มัน” (in English: focus on that) -- PROP-FLOOD-11 made the primary deliverable, finished completely before PROP-FLOOD-12.

version_history.statement: Initial registration: D2_k(t), the quadratic persistence-extrapolation level L(n), least-n horizon search with soundness/no-smaller-n (search_sound), the D2=0 reduction to PROP-FLOOD-02's linear ceiling (eta_D2_zero_matches_linear), monotonicity in D2 (eta_search_mono_D2/eta_search_mono_joint), the interval-enclosure form reusing PROP-FLOOD-10a's enclosure_sound directly (level_box_enclosure, eta_interval_enclosure), and the total four-way refusal wrapper (eta_readout, NO_RISE/SPARSE_SERIES/NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON/PUMP_STATE_CHANGED).
version_history.reason: Founder request 2026-10-05: watch the pond's rate of rise and its acceleration to tell when it overflows the bank; made the core thinking skill's primary, complete-first deliverable by the same-day founder follow-up.

version_history.statement: Revision after independent review (1 HIGH, 3 MED, 7 LOW findings; indexing n(n+1)/2, the D2=0 search reduction, Coq, reuse and attribution all held). Added: EtaAtBank, a distinct positive outcome (not a refusal) for theta<=h0, checked first (HIGH); NO_READOUT refusal when a retained sample the construction needs (h(t-k) or h(t-2k)) is itself missing; a 3-way pump flag (CHANGED/UNCHANGED/UNDECLARED) replacing the bare bool, with its own PUMP_STATE_UNDECLARED refusal and a declared window definition; a fixed refusal precedence (ALREADY_AT_BANK > NO_READOUT > PUMP > SPARSE_SERIES > NO_RISE > NOT_WITHIN_HORIZON); the genuine, verbatim founder quotes (replacing an earlier hand-transcribed copy that had introduced spelling errors); PROP-FLOOD-02's parent relation reworded from 'generalises' to 'extended', with what was merged vs added spelled out; PROP-FLOOD-03's neighbour relation reworded ('no statement of 03 is reused'); PROP-FLOOD-10a's evidence reworded ('open proposal, PR #64, Coq imported and compiled'); the Genesis quote's brackets corrected to the source's own 【…】; 'an earlier backtest of PROP-FLOOD-03' replacing an internal project-name reference; ETA now reported in both strides (n) and ticks (n*k), never conflated. New Coq: eta_readout_at_bank_iff, eta_readout_no_readout_iff, eta_readout_D2_zero_matches_T_k (PROP-FLOOD-02's own T_k-defined-ness condition, exactly), per-reason cause lemmas (eta_readout_pump_changed_iff, eta_readout_pump_undeclared_iff, eta_readout_sparse_iff, eta_readout_no_rise_iff, eta_readout_horizon_iff) replacing the earlier tautological eta_readout_refused_no_number, plus the Qeq-congruence and horizon-bound lemmas (level_qeq_D2/search_qeq/eta_search_qeq/search_upper_bound/eta_search_upper_bound) needed to state them, and the slower-Some-forces-faster-Some corollary eta_search_mono_joint_some_propagates. 17 -> 32 theorems/lemmas/corollaries, all still Closed under the global context, no axioms, no Admitted.
